articles.title: Andy Burnham praises UK-EU ties in meeting with Emmanuel Macron
articles.description: The pair discussed small boats, defence and Ukraine in Burnham's first bilateral talks in Downing Street.

articles.title: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply
articles.description: Once-rival criminal groups are being forced to work together because of a shortage of small boats, a BBC investigation has found.

articles.title: Watch: BBC witnesses 'taxi boat' picking up migrants multiple times in a day
articles.description: A BBC investigation has found smuggling gangs are running low on small boats, forcing rival gangs to work together and load more migrants on larger boats.

articles.title: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies, aged 92
articles.description: Her foundation said she "passed away peacefully" at her home in New York City, "surrounded by many who loved her".
